verdict.rationale: Exporting your own data is a fair question for a tax-filing portal, so the axis applies. The pack shows no documented capability to export all of a user's data in open formats. The only related item is downloading certificates and notices from the dashboard, which is a narrower, adjacent feature with no stated format and no full-data scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
